title: Agana Bridge to be passable to pedestrians, light vehicles — DPWH

blocks.text: The Agana Bridge in Tarlac City, which was damaged amid strong southwest monsoon rains last August 29, will be passable to pedestrians and light vehicles as early as Monday or Tuesday, the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) said Sunday.
